submission.natural_language_explanation: This pole is the neuron's default-on background state: it sits near its ceiling (~0.17, the GELU negative-lobe floor) on ordinary mid-sequence tokens regardless of topic, and collapses toward zero at sequence-initial tokens and at exactly the tokens where the sibling positive pole fires (e.g. 'the' after 'opened', 'three' after 'before'). Same-token contrasts ('days' 0.17 after 'after' vs ~0 after 'before'; 'the' 0.17 after 'and' vs ~0 after 'opened') rule out a pure token-identity account.
